objective: Propose the Jin Notes rebuild Wave 1 spec: (1) fix the title-only note bug by giving NoteDto a body_markdown field and having get_note read the body from disk; (2) redesign the note list into Apple-Notes-style rows (title + snippet + date) backed by a new index-side excerpt column. Folders + Obsidian editor are Wave 2 (seams only).

context_delta.summary: Decision-ready dual-format Wave-1 spec. 3 INVEST stories + 3 Kupo micro-tasks. S1 (P0 bug fix): add body_markdown to NoteDto (note.rs:7-18) and make api::get_note (api.rs:25-33) read the body fresh from NoteRow.file_path via fs::read_note; from_model=Some(body), from_row=None. S2 (P1, P0 if migration skipped): add an index-side excerpt column to the notes table; CRITICAL migration finding — schema::apply uses only CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS (schema.rs:114-116) so a guarded idempotent ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN is mandatory or existing index.sqlite crashes with no-such-column. Populate excerpt at rebuild via a pure derive_excerpt (whitespace-collapse + char-safe 200-char truncate); thread it through NoteRow + list/get SELECTs + NoteDto. S3 (P1): Apple-Notes flat rows (title + 2-line snippet + date) replacing the bubble card; scope new flat CSS under .note-row to leave Tasks/Events unchanged; pure formatNoteDate helper. Kupo: K1 version-gated one-time rebuild (no startup refresh exists in lib.rs:21-66 / ops::init early-returns) to populate pre-existing notes; K2 template/fixture parity guard (the test fixture template is a SEPARATE string from production #tmpl-note-row — known green-but-shallow trap); K3 dto comment + drift test. Mandatory anti-shallow gates: VG1.1 (Rust get_note body round-trip), VG1.4 (frontend invoke-mocked detail render), VG2.2 (Rust list excerpt round-trip), VG2.4 (frontend list row title+snippet+date). XSS textContent guard preserved. Wave-2 seams: get_note reads stored file_path (folder-safe); list DTO/query/fs are additive-friendly for a future folder_path/recursive param.
context_delta.wave_scope: Wave 1 of N (folders + Obsidian editor deferred to Wave 2)

expected_response.shape_hint: Build S1 first (P0, fully headless-verifiable via VG1.1). Then S2 with the MANDATORY guarded ALTER (R1/VG2.3). Then K1 || S3. Do NOT accept body coverage that only feeds the DTO into render by hand — VG1.1/VG1.4/VG2.2/VG2.4 are load-bearing anti-shallow gates.

assumptions: The SQLite index is a fully derived, disposable artifact rebuilt from canonical markdown files (rebuild.rs:22-30).
NoteRow.file_path (query.rs:18) is a readable path written by rebuild (rebuild.rs:50) and remains valid for fs::read_note.
One NoteDto serves both list and detail projections (api.rs:13-33).
Visual correctness of the Apple-Notes redesign is owner-verified via cargo tauri dev (browse.css header convention).
